Spikes for U5 and U7 include research time; effort estimates include that.
U6 assumes the Kafka upgrade is already applied but tests are failing; we fix the tests.
U3 is a process change involving branch creation and CI config adjustment.
All estimates are in work-hours for a single developer.
No external dependencies beyond existing libraries.
Testing includes unit and integration tests as appropriate.

activities.activity_description: Design approach for isolating ZK metadata per tenant using ZooKeeper chroot or prefix paths.
Implement changes to ZK client code to support tenant-specific namespaces.
Write unit and integration tests for namespace isolation.
Design interactive credential input mechanism for Admin server access.
Implement credential prompt, pass to server, avoid logging.
Write tests for the login flow.
Create maintenance branch from master, adjust versioning and CI configuration for minor releases.
Identify deprecated functions in module registry, Shell, and Admin-UI modules.
Remove deprecated functions and update all references.
Update and run tests to verify no side effects from removal.
Research whether to use ZK for storing admin server random port or other approach.
Implement in xd-shell the ability to retrieve admin server port from ZooKeeper.
Write tests for the discovery mechanism.
Identify tests failing after Kafka consumer upgrade and root cause.
Update test code to work with new Kafka consumer API (0.9 rewrite).
Run tests and ensure all pass.
Research Motion-JPEG format and implementation options for streaming ingest.
Design how to integrate Motion-JPEG with existing streaming infrastructure.
Implement encoder/decoder for Motion-JPEG and integrate with stream processing.
Write tests for Motion-JPEG streaming and facial detection integration.
Define config property for enabling/disabling message rates in cluster view.
Add YAML parsing for the new parameter and integrate into cluster view logic.
Write tests for the new config option.
